recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait of a female figure in a dark cocktail dress and opera gloves, set against a stark white background with a left-aligned vertical typographic stack featuring varied weights and a circular graphic element.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered horizontally but offset by left-aligned text
Dark silhouette of the figure against a pure white void
Vertical text orientation mirroring the elongated pose of the subject
Circular graphic accent breaking the linear verticality of the text block
coreInvariants: Dark satin or silk clothing textures
Crossed-arm pose creating a triangular torso shape

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body or three-quarter portrait centered in the right two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the circular graphic element in the text stack.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text, moves down the vertical stack, then shifts right to the subject's face and follows the arms down.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the subject and text, creating a clean, airy feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background for high-key contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black/navy for the subject's attire and primary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep burgundy or plum for the circular graphic and secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between background and subject; low saturation except for the accent color.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow)
Uniform stroke weight within each word
Geometric curves on rounded letters like 'O' and 'S'
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical stretching of the top-most name
Italicization for the text inside the circular element
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and widths of the same condensed sans-serif family, punctuated by a color-coded graphic element.
graphicDevices: Textured circular frame with a hand-painted or distressed edge effect

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the extreme verticality and condensed nature of the primary text.
Provides the necessary weight for the lower block of text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of a woman with short dark hair, wearing a dark satin dress and long gloves, posing with arms crossed against a seamless white background. Soft lighting to emphasize fabric sheen.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a vertical stack of text on the left side. Use ultra-condensed sans-serif fonts. Include a plum-colored distressed circle containing italicized text in the middle of the stack. Use gray for the bottom-most word.

verificationChecks: Does the circular element have a textured edge?
Is the subject's clothing showing satin-like highlights?

adjustableVariables: Accent color (plum to gold or teal)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Original artist name and album title text

avoid: Default system fonts like Arial or Helvetica

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the vertical text does not overlap the subject.
Check that the white background is blown out but subject skin tones remain natural.
Verify the distressed texture on the circular graphic is visible.
Confirm the ultra-condensed font proportions are maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + high-key white background + left-aligned vertical ultra-condensed typography + one circular graphic accent.
